title: geophila tenuis
intro: Geophila tenuis, commonly known as Spurred Coralroot, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Pyrolaceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its potential to alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Geophila tenuis are attributed to its ability to stimulate the excretion of mucus, thereby relieving congestion and promoting easier breathing. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
